To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) the proposed framework is capable of modeling uncertainty and conflict, and (b) the framework can be used to draw different conclusions depending upon the application context (view).

(1) we propose a novel argumentation framework to model uncertainty in open domain applications; (2) we give a formal analysis of conflicts incurred in uncertain knowledge and show that the conflicts can be resolved by different views of knowledge; (3) we show that our framework is more expressive and flexible than existing frameworks; (4) we show the practical usefulness by an illustrative example of strategical decision support.
(1) conflicts and uncertainties are two distinct concepts and (2) conflicts and uncertainties should be handled separately.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a formal framework to support the resolution of conflicts under uncertainties in open domain applications.
the development of a framework for resolving conflicting arguments under uncertainties.
the development of an integrated framework to model and reason about conflicts and uncertainties in a holistic view.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed framework is an important step towards a holistic framework that can support the development of knowledge based systems in open domains.
our approach is the first to provide a formal framework for resolving conflicting arguments under uncertainties.

we have developed an integrated framework for reasoning with uncertainty and conflicts, which supports different views on conflicting and uncertain knowledge, and thus, allows for drawing different conclusions depending on application context.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide an integrated framework for resolving conflicting and uncertain knowledge in open domain applications.
we provide a formalism to model and manage conflicts under uncertainty.
we propose a novel framework to resolve conflicts incurred by uncertainty in a multi-viewed manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
conflicts and uncertainties can be addressed in a holistic manner by integrating the three views.
conflicts and uncertainties are not to be resolved separately.
conflicts are not necessarily a negative phenomenon, they can be used to support the decision making process.
